title: Reducing the Resources Required by ADAPT-VQE Using Coupled Exchange Operators and Improved Subroutines
problem_summary: Introduces the Coupled Exchange Operator (CEO) pool: linear combinations of excitation operators acting on the same spin-orbitals, capable of simultaneously realizing exchanges between multiple Slater-determinant pairs (unlike standard single-pair excitation operators). Reports over 50% parameter-count reduction vs UCCSD-VQE on LiH/BeH2 with improved accuracy, plus large measurement-cost reductions.

components.family_or_name: Coupled Exchange Operator (CEO) pool -- OVP-CEO (one shared variational parameter) and MVP-CEO (independently parameterized) variants
components.notes: Each CEO operator can realize exchanges between multiple Slater-determinant pairs simultaneously.
Benchmark systems used to report the parameter-count and measurement-cost reductions.

components.family_or_name: parameter-count reduction via CEO pooling (>50% average reduction vs UCCSD-VQE on LiH/BeH2)

workflow_composition_notes: ADAPT-VQE-style adaptive growth loop, with the operator pool restricted to Coupled Exchange Operators instead of individual fermionic excitations, plus 'improved subroutines' (paper title) for measurement/circuit-depth reduction.
